Announcement

Thank you very much to everyone who participated in “Usuda Pekora and 100 People Minecraft”! 
As we announced to all participants on the Discord server the other day, we would like to inform you about the distribution of the world for “Usuda Pekora and 100 People Minecraft”.
Please enjoy it within the scope of your personal use, observing the following precautions.

【Version】
  java edition release 1.20.4
 
【Notes】
The data is as of the time of the server shutdown on October 31st.
The distribution may end without notice.
Reproduction and secondary distribution of this URL is strictly prohibited.
Please refrain from distributing or posting data obtained from this distribution.
We do not accept inquiries regarding the world data. Please use it at your own risk.
Please note that the total data size is 121.92GB.

【Distribution URL】

Password: z8QsqZ

That's all.
Thank you very much for enjoying this project!
Please continue to support Usada Peco!
